$description: Wave 7 (W7 Data Display) component tokens for Alert. Reuse Check (component-engineer.md item 0): no existing component owns 'persistent inline feedback banner' — Toast/Snackbar are transient+floating (portal, auto-dismiss, z-index:toast), Badge is a tiny inline label with no title/description/dismiss slot. Alert fills a distinct anatomy (static in-flow block with icon + title + description + optional dismiss). Colors are 100% reused, not invented: `variant.*` (accent bar + icon glyph, needs 3:1) aliases the SAME `color.feedback.*` tokens Toast's `variant.*` already uses (D-006, locked) plus `color.border.interactive` for the neutral 'default' case (same choice Toast made for its own 'default' variant). `content.bg.*`/`content.text.*` alias the SAME `color.role.*.subtleBg`/`color.role.*.subtleText` tokens Badge already uses (D-013) — Alert's tinted-panel treatment is Badge's subtle recipe scaled up to block level, not a new hue or a new tint formula. `content.text.body` reuses `color.text.default` (the same body-copy token every other component uses) so the description line stays legible regardless of variant tint. `content.border` reuses `color.border.hairline` (D-008: hairline replaces decorative shadow for definition in normal flow — Alert is not a floating layer so it does NOT get shadow.elevation.* the way Toast/Popover/Dialog do). Contrast self-check (computed directly from resolved hex in build/css/{light,dark}.css, relative-luminance formula, both themes): text.default (body) on every variant's subtleBg = 11.11-12.39:1 both themes (text minimum 4.5:1, huge margin) · role subtleText (title/icon) on subtleBg = light 5.28-8.40:1 / dark 6.38-9.11:1 (text minimum 4.5:1, passes) · success/warning/danger/info variant.accent (feedback.*, non-text UI needs 3:1) on their own subtleBg = light 3.85-5.87:1 / dark 5.33-5.46:1, all pass 3:1 comfortably. EXCEPTION (inherits E-001/D-019/D-021 scope, same token+same decorative-accent role as Toast, not a new exception): `default` variant's accent (`color.border.interactive`, neutral.500) on neutral subtleBg measures light 3.47:1 (passes) / **dark 2.99:1** (~0.5% under 3:1) — identical shortfall to Toast's already-accepted default-variant accent bar. Scope stays exactly as narrow as E-001: this is a decorative accent bar (not the panel boundary — the panel's definition comes from `content.border`=`color.border.hairline`, a quiet divider already accepted at sub-3:1 contrast by D-014/D-019 precedent), and non-color cues (a distinct icon per variant, per the braun-flat non-color-cue rule) carry the actual variant distinction so the accent bar is reinforcement, not the sole signal. Not cited as new precedent beyond this narrow decorative-accent case.
